trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: The Yokudan gods recognize a kept orthodoxy. Honorable combat sharpens your blade for a time; tomb sites draw the ancestors near.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: The Yokudan gods recognize the unclean duty borne. Cleansing a tomb restores full health on next rest; undead deal 15% less harm.

draft_prose: Tu'whacca draws the Far Shores nearer. Undead deal up to 25% less harm; a completed death-rite restores full health, and the dead feel present at the tombs.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: HoonDing makes the way. Once a week, an impossible-odds victory returns a day-long surge of combat strength.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Crown Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Inheritance Kept" Body: "You carried the old way into exile and did not let it thin -- the blade, the bearing, the rites, all intact. The ancestors who died holding Hammerfell see their orthodoxy alive in you."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Crown Devoted + tomb site; one per in-game day.
draft_prose: At the tomb, the ancestors feel close and approving.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Forebear Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Way Made" Body: "You made a life in a province that was never yours, and stayed Redguard doing it. That is the way-making. The god who held the Alik'r line knows the same quality in you."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Forebear Devoted + hard passage; per qualifying event.
draft_prose: The road yields. HoonDing's way-making is in your step.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Ash'abah Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Burden-Bearer's Grace" Body: "You did the work your own people will not thank you for. You cleansed the unclean dead and bore the stigma. The god of the Far Shores is grateful, even where the living are not."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Ash'abah Devoted + major tomb or death site; one per in-game day.
draft_prose: At the death-site, Tu'whacca's presence is close.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: You have handled the dead carelessly. The Far Shores seem further away.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing; Crown sect.
draft_prose: Yokudan practice has slid into Divines convenience. The orthodoxy thins.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing; Forebear sect.
draft_prose: You have taken only the easy road. HoonDing does not notice the safe.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing; Ash'abah sect.
draft_prose: The undead duty goes unmet. The burden is just weight now, unhonored.

deity_tone: Satakal: The Worldskin; vast, cyclical; speaks of the shedding, of creation and destruction as one motion, of death as correct when its time has come.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Satakal's Cycle" Body: "You have lived as one who knows the Worldskin sheds. Carry Satakal as your own, and the great cycle becomes your devotion. Will you?"

trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Tu'whacca's Charge" Body: "You tend the dead and turn back the undead. Carry Tu'whacca as your own, and the guidance of souls to the Far Shores is your charge. Will you?"

deity_tone: Ruptga: Tall Papa, the pathfinder; the first to find the Far Shores; speaks of the way charted and of survival as a sacred achievement.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Ruptga's Path" Body: "You have made ways and charted survival. Carry Ruptga, Tall Papa, as your own, and the path itself becomes your faith. Will you?"

deity_tone: Leki: Saint of the Spirit Sword; disciplined, exact; speaks of the blade as devotion, the honorable cut, the art learned with patience.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Leki's Blade" Body: "Your sword-work is disciplined and honest. Carry Leki as your own, and the blade becomes devotion made exact. Will you?"

deity_tone: Tava: The bird-god of wind and passage; speaks of safe arrival, the road carried, the storm steered through.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Tava's Wind" Body: "The road has carried you far, and you have carried it well. Carry Tava as your own, and the wind of good passage is yours. Will you?"

deity_tone: HoonDing: The Make-Way God; surges and does not linger; speaks only in the moment a way is forced where there was none.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "HoonDing's Call" Body: "Again and again you have made a way where there was none. Carry the Make-Way God as your own, and the impossible passage becomes your devotion. Will you?"

trigger: MessageBox. Shared across Redguard offers.
draft_prose: Walk under this god.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; curated Yokudan-form hooks.
draft_prose: You kept Yokudan form where Divines convenience beckoned. Counted.

trigger: MessageBox. Rare major; honorable adversity only; curated milestone, weekly cap.
draft_prose: Title: "Sacred Survival" Body: "You came through honorable adversity that should have ended you. Ruptga charted such ways first, and HoonDing forces them still. The Far Shores draw a little nearer."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental; reject fast travel.
draft_prose: The road carried you well. Tava's wind was with the journey.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; honored contract, not gold-making.
draft_prose: A contract honored under pressure. Pragmatic honor, and it counts.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; identity kept while cooperating.
draft_prose: You cooperated with outsiders and stayed Redguard doing it.

trigger: MessageBox. Rare major; impossible-odds only; curated milestone, weekly cap.
draft_prose: Title: "The Way Forced" Body: "Severely outmatched, and still you made a way through. That is my whole nature. The god who held the Dominion back is in your step."

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; per site/boss, not repeat farm.
draft_prose: The unclean dead are put to rest. Tu'whacca marks the work.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; per hold/quest.
draft_prose: The burial duty is kept. The burden is bearable when honored.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; ordinary impurity-bearing.
draft_prose: You bore the duty no one else would touch. It is seen.

trigger: MessageBox. Marked only for costly burden moments.
draft_prose: Title: "The Burden Honored" Body: "You did the work your own people recoil from, and you paid its cost in their eyes. I do not recoil. The Far Shores keep a place for the burden-bearer."

trigger: MessageBox. Rare major; major tomb or named undead boss; weekly cap.
draft_prose: Title: "A Way Through the Unclean" Body: "You cut a path through ritual uncleanness that would have turned anyone else back. The way is made. The dead behind you can rest."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Per token use; daily cap on the favor it feeds.
draft_prose: You tend the Far Shores token and speak to Tu'whacca.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Player-owned property or authored private shrine context.
draft_prose: Tended within your own walls, the rite carries further.

trigger: MessageBox. Once on becoming vampire; devotion collapses across all sects.
draft_prose: Title: "Outside the Cycle" Body: "You are undead now, and undeath is a soul that has left the cycle I guide. The Far Shores cannot receive you while the curse holds. Devotion across all three sects falls quiet. Cure this, and return to me first."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on cure; Tu'whacca re-entry precedes other devotion.
draft_prose: Title: "Right Re-Entry" Body: "The curse is lifted. Come back through me before any other god -- proper mortality, ancestor order, the right return to the cycle. When that is done, the Far Shores are open, and your sect may have you again."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on first transformation; strained, not severed.
draft_prose: Title: "Strained, Not Severed" Body: "The beast is in you. The Yokudan gods and your sect remain within reach, but strained -- Hircine is an intrusion, not a home. The ancestors do not turn away. They only watch more closely."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on werewolf cure; strain lifts.
draft_prose: Title: "The Strain Lifts" Body: "The beast is set down. The strain eases, and the Yokudan gods and your sect come back into full reach. Hircine's intrusion is ended. The ancestors, who only watched more closely, ease their gaze. Wholly theirs again."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Faithful or above.
draft_prose: "I keep the Yokudan way as the Alik'r kept Hammerfell. What is needed?"

trigger: Dialogue topic; Tu'whacca Devoted or Ash'abah sect.
draft_prose: "I tend the dead for Tu'whacca. What restless ones are here?"

trigger: Dialogue topic; Ash'abah Devoted.
draft_prose: "The unclean dead are my charge. Tell me what walks here."
